name: proxy_v1
source: this repository (S3): the IR proxy's classes, each a stated temperature model and one cited ASTER spectral library row (assets/emissivity/, sha256 and provenance checked); the mappings below are declared stand-ins, not measurements of any scene

aircraft_skin.source: ASTER JHU/NPIC 0384UUUALM Aluminum Metal (bare, weathered and scored): a bare aluminium skin; a painted skin (far higher emissivity) is not represented

engine.source: no sub-object temperatures: the class image carries no engine pixels, so no engine or plume temperature is stated or used

valley.source: ASTER JHU green rye grass: the engine's valley-floor vegetation colour and the grassland / cropland land cover

scrub.source: ASTER JHU dry grass: the engine's scrub colour and the shrubland land cover (a stand-in; no shrub row is cached)

rock.source: ASTER JHU Granite.H1 alkalic granite: the engine's rock colour (slopes above 34 degrees)

snow.source: ASTER JHU fine snow (24 um): the engine's snow colour and the snow and ice land cover

trees.source: ASTER JHU deciduous trees: the tree cover and mangrove land cover

concrete.source: ASTER JHU/NPIC 0432UUUCNC construction concrete: labelled buildings and the built-up land cover

soil.source: ASTER JHU 89P1763 light yellowish brown clay (aridisol): the bare / sparse vegetation land cover

asphalt.source: ASTER JHU/NPIC 0095UUUASP construction asphalt: a labelled runway pad

water.source: no water row is cached: water pixels are written unmodelled (NaN) and counted, never guessed

palette_source: ue/Plugins/FlightSimBridge/Source/FlightSimBridge/Private/FlightSimVisualScene.cpp ClassifyVertex: the engine's four vertex colours (calibrated to read as rock / forest / snow, labelled approximated in every manifest)
landcover_source: ESA WorldCover v200 legend codes (core/terrain/landcover.py LEGEND) mapped to the cached rows; moss and lichen has no row and is unmodelled
not_claimed: the class-to-row mappings are declared stand-ins (a grass row for cropland, a dry grass row for shrubland), not measured emissivities of the scene
one temperature per class; no class states a solar-loading term
